title: Baugh Bullies the Rebels: Gators Lead No. 4 Ole Miss 17-3 at the Half
excerpt: Jadan Baugh ran for two touchdowns, Aaron Chiles forced a fumble and No. 21 Florida leads No. 4 Ole Miss 17-3 at halftime in The Swamp.
coverAlt: GatorBait Media halftime graphic: No. 21 Florida 17, No. 4 Ole Miss 3. Jadan Baugh has two rushing touchdowns.
body: GAINESVILLE — Jadan Baugh has two touchdowns, the Florida defense has a takeaway and No. 21 Florida leads No. 4 Ole Miss 17-3 at halftime at Ben Hill Griffin Stadium.

Baugh finished the opening drive with a 4-yard run and scored again from 2 yards out with 2:51 left in the half, his 10th touchdown of the season. Patrick Durkin added a 49-yard field goal after Aaron Chiles forced a fumble by JT Lindsey, one of the backs filling in for Ole Miss star Kewan Lacy.
Ole Miss, playing without Lacy and nine other players ruled out before kickoff, has only a 36-yard Lucas Carneiro field goal. A pass-interference penalty set up that drive at the Florida 48.

The margin could be wider. A 67-yard Aaron Philo touchdown pass to Vernell Brown III was wiped out by a holding penalty early in the second quarter. On the drive that produced Baugh's second score, Rebels safety Joenel Aguero was flagged for targeting and disqualified,
Rebels quarterback Trinidad Chambliss went down in the first quarter and walked to the sideline on his own while backup Deuce Knight stepped in. Chambliss was back on the Rebels' next possession.
Ole Miss wins the toss and defers. J'Vari Flowers returns the opening kickoff 23 yards to the Florida 35.
Baugh 4-yard run, Durkin kick. The 8-play, 65-yard drive included Baugh runs of 12 and 23 yards and a 13-yard Philo pass to Luke Harpring.
Chiles forces a Lindsey fumble on third-and-2, and Florida takes over at the 31.
Chambliss goes down; Knight comes in. Chambliss returns on the next series.
Philo's 67-yard touchdown pass to Brown is nullified by holding on Bailey Stockton. Florida punts.
Carneiro, 36 yards. Pass interference on Lagonza Hayward gave Ole Miss the ball at the Florida 48, and a facemask penalty on Jeramiah McCloud added 15 yards.
Philo's third-and-8 pass is tipped and caught by TJ Abrams for 15 yards. Aguero is flagged for targeting, and Stockton is shaken up on the play. First-and-goal Florida.
